╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  zmk-keybeacon 1.1.4 is INCOMPATIBLE with the current ZMK revision   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

Current ZMK:    702fc69  (/Users/wangyuting19/kbd/keybeacon/zmk-keybeacon/scripts/tests/fixtures/zmk-missing)
Known-good:    [e844eca2 .. 4dd95d7]  (as of zmk-keybeacon 1.1.4 release)

Missing symbol: zmk_endpoints_selected
  Location expected:  /Users/wangyuting19/kbd/keybeacon/zmk-keybeacon/scripts/tests/fixtures/zmk-missing/app/include/zmk/endpoints.h
  Called from:        keybeacon.c
  Likely cause:       upstream ZMK renamed/removed this symbol after
                      4dd95d7 (see ZMK main-HEAD history).

─── How to fix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Pick ONE of the following:

[1] Pin ZMK back to a known-good revision (recommended):
      In your zmk-config's west.yml, under `projects:` → `zmk`:
          revision: 4dd95d7
      Then:
          west update && west build -p

[2] Upgrade zmk-keybeacon to a tag that supports newer ZMK:
      Check https://github.com/ykiewang/zmk-keybeacon/releases
      for a tag released after 702fc69 landed on ZMK main.

[3] Opt out of the compatibility check (NOT RECOMMENDED — build may
    still fail with cryptic C errors, and runtime behaviour is undefined):
      In your prj.conf / <your_shield>.conf, add:
          CONFIG_ZMK_KEYBEACON_ALLOW_INCOMPATIBLE_ZMK=y

─── Also ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Please DO NOT disable individual characteristics in your .conf as a
workaround (e.g. CONFIG_ZMK_KEYBEACON_CHAR_CONNECTIVITY=n). That path
silently removes host-side features and masks the real issue.
